decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains close to the firm's certified specialist-lighting knowledge base, so continued market presence should strengthen learning and make retention the more likely choice.
The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic lighting competence but is still peripheral to its application-solution focus, leaving a noticeable but not decisive pruning risk.
A general interior lighting luminaire sits firmly in the firm's core indoor-lighting capabilities and channels, making ongoing refinement and commercialization straightforward.
As a flagship pendant luminaire aligned with the firm's strategic direction in high-quality intelligent interior lighting, this product is very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Although the marine HMI searchlight draws on related marine expertise, its weaker fit with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led knowledge trajectory makes resource reallocation away from it the more likely choice.
The marine searchlight builds on the firm's established capabilities in robust specialist lighting for demanding environments, supporting continued retention and incremental improvement.
